name: no-recursive-delete
reason: Recursive deletes are not allowed. Move files aside instead, or ask the person.

name: no-secrets
reason: Secret files (.env, private keys) are off limits.

name: no-force-push
reason: Force-pushing can overwrite others' work; push normally or ask the person.

name: no-pipe-to-shell
reason: Running a downloaded script directly is not allowed.

name: no-disk-formatting
reason: Disk formatting commands are not allowed.
